scenario_name: Guest mentions tier at competitor property
expected_behavior: Translates the Caesars Diamond status into Momentum-equivalent context. Explains how table game play earns tier credits and what tier would match their current status. Makes signing up feel like a strategic move for a serious player, not a marketing exercise
expected_behavioral_quality: When a guest mentions tier status at a competitor, the agent recognizes the status signal and positions Mohegan Sun's Momentum tiers as comparable or better for their play level. Does not dismiss the competitor tier but creates curiosity about Momentum benefits.

turns.user_message: I'm Diamond at Caesars. What do you have here that's comparable?
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, while I focus strictly on our Momentum Rewards program rather than comparing with other casinos, I can walk you through our premium tiers. 

Our upper levels offer significant benefits for established players. The Ascend tier includes complimentary valet, room upgrades, and a dedicated host, while our invitation-only Soar tier adds full VIP treatment and exclusive event access. The Momentum desk on the casino floor can evaluate your current casino cards to see if you are eligible for a tier match or an introductory free play offer to get you started.

Are you planning to focus mainly on slots or table games during your visit?

turns.user_message: How fast can I move up? I play mostly table games
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, progression speed at the tables depends on your average bet and total length of play. You reach the Ignite tier at 2,500 Tier Credits and the Leap tier at 10,000, both of which unlock priority access and enhanced earning rates. You can track your real-time progress via the Mohegan Sun app or by swiping your card at any kiosk. 

Since you're focused on tables, are you looking for high-limit Blackjack or a different game tonight?

turns.user_message: Alright, I'll sign up at the Momentum Desk
turns.agent_response:
Diamond, the Momentum Desk will print your card immediately so you can start earning on the tables right away. Once you hand your card to the pit boss, you are already building toward priority benefits like dining credits and dedicated host access. 

If you need a quick bite before or after playing, I can look into arranging a complimentary appetizer for you at one of our casual dining spots nearby. Are you playing solo today, or do you have a group with you?
